facts.claim: Flight 501 on 4 June 1996 was normal until about 37 seconds; between 37 and 39 seconds both booster nozzles and the Vulcain nozzle swivelled to their limits

The backup and active inertial reference systems failed almost simultaneously after a 64-bit floating-point value was converted to a 16-bit signed integer and overflowed in software reused from Ariane 4
Full nozzle deflection from the flawed data drove the angle of attack above 20 degrees, the aerodynamic loads broke the launcher up and it self-destructed
Ariane 5 flew a faster trajectory than Ariane 4, so the horizontal velocity value grew too large for the 16-bit integer
Ariane 5 stands 46 to 52 m tall with a 5.4 m core stage and two 31.6 m solid boosters 3.06 m across
Reused software is now re-verified against the new vehicle's real flight profile
